```{r}
#| label: setup
pkg_root <- rprojroot::find_package_root_file()
devtools::load_all(pkg_root, quiet = TRUE)

old_ref <- "4e0813a^"
old_rda <- tempfile(fileext = ".rda")
system2(
  "git",
  c("-C", pkg_root, "show", paste0(old_ref, ":R/sysdata.rda")),
  stdout = old_rda
)
old_env <- new.env()
load(old_rda, envir = old_env)
ma_old <- old_env$molar_absorption
ma_new <- molar_absorption

p_abs_with <- function(ma) {
  f <- p_abs
  environment(f) <- list2env(
    list(molar_absorption = ma, report_surrogate = function(pah) NULL),
    parent = asNamespace("pahwq")
  )
  f
}
p_abs_old <- p_abs_with(ma_old)
p_abs_new <- p_abs_with(ma_new)

spectrum_of <- function(ma, chem) {
  s <- unique(ma$surrogate[ma$chemical == chem])
  if (length(s) == 0) {
    return("none")
  }
  if (is.na(s)) "measured" else paste("mean of", s)
}

scenarios <- list(
  "BC lake" = list(
    depth_m = 0.5,
    lat = 53,
    lon = -122,
    elev_m = 700,
    DOC = 5,
    date = "2023-06-21"
  ),
  "BC marine" = list(
    depth_m = 0.5,
    lat = 49.15085,
    lon = -125.91427,
    elev_m = 0,
    aq_env = "marine",
    date = "2023-06-21"
  )
)
```

## What was compared

Phototoxic CWQGs calculated with the absorption spectra before and after #72, which added the new CCME measured spectra (Appendix F-1 to F-5) and averaged surrogate spectra (F-6).

- Both use the current log KOW values (#71), so differences come only from the spectra.
- "Before" uses `molar_absorption` from ``r old_ref``, the commit before the rebuild.
- Two scenarios, both on 21 June at 0.5 m depth:
  - **BC lake:** 53°N, 122°W, 700 m elevation, DOC 5 mg/L.
  - **BC marine:** 49.15°N, 125.9°W, Kd from the marine models.
- Chemicals whose spectra only gained wavelengths with zero absorption are left out, since their guidelines do not change.

```{r}
#| label: compare
options(pahwq.tuv_data_dir = file.path(tempfile(), "tuv_data"))
setup_tuv_dir()

results <- lapply(names(scenarios), function(scn) {
  do.call(tuv, c(scenarios[[scn]], quiet = TRUE))
  res <- get_tuv_results()
  pacs <- pac_list()
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pacs)), function(i) {
    chem <- pacs$chemical[i]
    has_old <- chem %in% ma_old$chemical
    pabs_old <- if (has_old) p_abs_old(res, chem) else NA_real_
    pabs_new <- p_abs_new(res, chem)
    data.frame(
      scenario = scn,
      pac = pacs$pac[i],
      chemical = chem,
      app = pacs$app[i],
      spectrum_old = if (has_old) spectrum_of(ma_old, chem) else "none",
      spectrum_new = spectrum_of(ma_new, chem),
      pabs_old = pabs_old,
      pabs_new = pabs_new,
      cwqg_old = if (has_old) {
        phototoxic_cwqg(pabs_old, pah = chem)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      cwqg_new = phototoxic_cwqg(pabs_new, pah = chem)
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
})
results <- do.call(rbind, results)
results$pct_change <- round(100 * (results$cwqg_new / results$cwqg_old - 1), 1)

pabs_changed <- tapply(
  is.na(results$pabs_old) | abs(results$pabs_new - results$pabs_old) > 1e-9,
  results$chemical,
  any
)
results <- results[pabs_changed[results$chemical], ]

write.csv(
  results,
  "guideline-comparison-72.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

pct <- function(chem, scn) {
  x <- results$pct_change[results$chemical == chem & results$scenario == scn]
  paste0(if (x > 0) "+", x, "%")
}
```

## Results

`r length(unique(results$chemical))` chemicals change. A negative change means a lower (stricter) guideline. The full results, with Pabs and CWQG values for each chemical and scenario, are written to `guideline-comparison-72.csv`.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary
fmt_pct <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "new", paste0(ifelse(x > 0, "+", ""), x, "%"))
}
wide <- reshape(
  results[c("scenario", "pac", "spectrum_old", "spectrum_new", "pct_change")],
  idvar = c("pac", "spectrum_old", "spectrum_new"),
  timevar = "scenario",
  direction = "wide"
)
wide <- unique(wide)
wide <- wide[order(wide$`pct_change.BC lake`, na.last = TRUE), ]
wide$`pct_change.BC lake` <- fmt_pct(wide$`pct_change.BC lake`)
wide$`pct_change.BC marine` <- fmt_pct(wide$`pct_change.BC marine`)
knitr::kable(
  wide,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("PAC", "Old spectrum", "New spectrum", "Lake", "Marine")
)
```

## Points for the Project Team

- **The old spectra stopped at 411 nm.** Perylene, indeno(1,2,3-cd)pyrene and benzanthrone absorb beyond that, so their guidelines drop now that the full spectra are used (perylene: `r pct("perylene", "BC lake")` in the lake, `r pct("perylene", "BC marine")` at the marine site).
- **Lake and marine results can differ in direction for the same group.** C2-phenanthrenes change by `r pct("c2-phenanthrenes", "BC lake")` in the lake but `r pct("c2-phenanthrenes", "BC marine")` at the marine site; C1-pyrenes change by `r pct("c1-pyrenes", "BC lake")` and `r pct("c1-pyrenes", "BC marine")`. DOC in the lake removes more short-wavelength UV than the clear marine water, so where each surrogate absorbs matters.
- **Averaging in a weakly absorbing surrogate raises the guideline.** 9-methylphenanthrene absorbs much less than 9-methylanthracene in this range, so averaging the two raises the C1-phenanthrenes guideline by `r pct("c1-phenanthrenes", "BC lake")` in the lake.
- **Only the spectra are compared here.** The log KOW changes in #71 also move the guidelines and are not included.
